sharedRules.name: Isolation
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is XENOMORPHS:
■ If your opponent cannot draw a straight line horizontally from the closest point of the base of any model in their unit to the closest point of the base of any model in another unit from their army without crossing over the base of a model from your army, that unit is Isolated.
■ While an enemy unit is more than 9" horizontally away from any other enemy unit, that unit is Isolated.

Each time a XENOMORPHS unit from your army makes an attack that targets an Isolated unit, improve the BS/WS characteristic of that attack by 1 (to a maximum of 2+) or, if the BS/WS characteristic of that attack is an unmodified 2+, add 1 to the hit roll.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: While a friendly XENOMORPHS unit is within 12" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and re-roll a wound roll of 1.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
While a friendly XENOMORPHS unit is within 12" of this model:
■ That unit has +1 OC.
■ You can re-roll leadership rolls made for that unit.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
While a friendly XENOMORPHS unit is within 12" of this model:
■ Add 1 to advance and charge rolls made for that unit.
■ You can re-roll charge rolls made for that unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Q. If a model has the FRAME keyword, how is the Isolation rule measured?
A. Instead of measuring to/from the closest point of the base, measure to/from the closest point on that model.

Q. For the Isolation rule, can you measure from your unit to any unit from your army when determining if it's Isolated?
A. Yes.

Q. When re-selecting a Pheromone ability with the Shifting Tides stratagem, is the Pheromone ability on a Praetorian with the Royal Jelly enhancement replaced too?
A. Yes.
